prerequisites: Being a first-year introductory course, there are no specific requirements. However, it is recommended to consider the general requirements for admission to the degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, enabling them to learn new methods and theories, and providing them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, and critical reasoning.
Ability to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and aptitudes in the field of Mechanical Engineering, both orally and in writing, and to all types of audiences.
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, labor plans, and other similar works.
Ability to organize and plan in the field of business, and other institutions and organizations.
Honesty, responsibility, ethical commitment, and solidarity spirit.
Ability to work in a team.
Adequate knowledge of the concept of a company, its institutional and legal framework. Organization and management of companies.
Understand the concept of a company, types of companies, and the environment in which it operates.
Be able to understand the different subsystems that integrate the company.
Understand the principles of business organization and management.

syllabus_topics: Functioning of economic activity and types of markets
Concept and objectives of the company
Types of companies: economic, organizational, and legal criteria
Asset and results analysis for decision making
Valuation of investment and financing projects
teaching_methods: Case analysis based on reading documents and watching videos
Presentation of individual or group assignments
assessment_rules: The final grade in the ordinary call is the sum of the final exam (65%), three evaluative practices (10% each), and participation (5%). To pass, a minimum of 40% is required for the final exam (2.6/6.5 points) and for the sum of practices and participation (1.4/3.5 points), with an overall minimum of 5 points. If minimums are not met but the overall grade is above 5, the final grade will be 4. For extraordinary calls, previous grades that met their minimums can be retained; otherwise, students must take new theoretical-practical and/or practical exams, each with specific minimums.
